subtitles.skyabyss.sky_wingbeat: Something vast beats its wings overhead
subtitles.skyabyss.sky_call: A voice falls from above the clouds
item.skyabyss.sky_key_fragment.desc: Warm, faintly beating. Four together, they say, open a way above the clouds
message.skyabyss.song_look_up: A low song is coming down from the sky. Look up.
message.skyabyss.chain_hint: Right-click the chain to be pulled up onto its back
message.skyabyss.descending: At your touch, the chain slowly lowers you to the ground
message.skyabyss.resonance: A resonance stone begins to sing (%s / %s)
message.skyabyss.gate_opened: Three songs align, and the seal exhales
message.skyabyss.room_busy: Another party is taking this trial right now. Wait until they leave
message.skyabyss.sealed_gate: The seal holds fast. It seems to wait for stones to sing
title.skyabyss.titan_back.sub: An old guardian crossing a sea of clouds
commands.skyabyss.titan.summoned: The Stone Whale swims in from beyond the sky
commands.skyabyss.titan.resting: The Stone Whale descends toward you
commands.skyabyss.titan.missing: No Stone Whale found (it is not in a loaded area)
message.skyabyss.chain_slack: The chain has not reached the ground yet
message.skyabyss.arrived_back: Only the wind. You stand on a ledge outside the anchor stone, on the stone whale's left flank. A stair climbs through its body to the east
message.skyabyss.guide.village: The village folk must have seen that shadow too. The nearest village lies to the %s, about %s blocks away. Find its storyteller
message.skyabyss.guide.camp: Smoke rises from a campfire nearby. A wandering storyteller seems to be resting by it
message.skyabyss.titan_appears: Somewhere in the distant sky, something is singing...
message.skyabyss.titan_descends: The Stone Whale descends. A chain falls from the anchor on its back
message.skyabyss.stay_ending.whale: The Stone Whale will leave soon
message.skyabyss.stay_ending.tide: The Tide Shell will leave soon
message.skyabyss.stay_ending.storm: The Thunder Wing will leave soon
message.skyabyss.stay_ending.ember: The Ember Titan will leave soon
message.skyabyss.titan_refuses: The titan's body refuses a stranger's hand
message.skyabyss.camp.limit: You can only set up 8 camp tools on one titan back
message.skyabyss.camp.mechanism: Camp tools cannot be placed near a mechanism
message.skyabyss.camp.arena: Camp tools cannot be placed in battle rooms or on trial platforms
message.skyabyss.camp.support: Camp tools can only be placed on the ground or a wall of the back (not on another tool or in mid-air)
message.skyabyss.camp.stranger: You cannot take down another person's camp tool
message.skyabyss.camp.returned: Your camp tools came back to you (%s)
message.skyabyss.stone_silent: While the guards are awake, the stone stays silent
message.skyabyss.return_opened: A sealed shortcut back the way you came slides open without a sound
message.skyabyss.arena_next: The creak of bone has not stopped yet...
message.skyabyss.arena_cleared: The last guard crumbles. The stone awaits your voice
message.skyabyss.arena_reset: The guards return to their sleep
commands.skyabyss.titan.rebuilt: Rebuilt the Stone Whale's back (trials reset)
message.skyabyss.hall_begin: The hall doors slam shut. The guards awaken
message.skyabyss.hall_cleared: The hall falls silent. The way forward opens
message.skyabyss.fell_pit: You lost your footing... and were pulled back to the last rest
message.skyabyss.revived_on_back: You come to. The titan's heartbeat seems to have carried you back
message.skyabyss.fragment_received: You received a Sky Key Fragment. It is faintly warm
message.skyabyss.fragment_already: The pedestal is quiet. You have already taken your Sky Key Fragment
commands.skyabyss.titan.reset: Reset the trials on the Stone Whale's back
message.skyabyss.heart_begin: The doors have sealed. The heart of the stone whale begins to beat
message.skyabyss.heart_abandoned: No one remains in the heart chamber. The heart sleeps again and the doors open
message.skyabyss.gate_gathering: The doors close in %s seconds. Anyone joining, come to the antechamber or step inside
message.skyabyss.gate_wait: You wake. The doors open to you again in %s s
message.skyabyss.gate_ready: To the door. You may return to the fight (%s left)
message.skyabyss.gate_ready_free: To the door. You may return to the fight
message.skyabyss.gate_rejoin: The doors remember you. You return to the fight
message.skyabyss.gate_fallen: You have used up your returns. Watch from outside the door until the fight ends
message.skyabyss.rest_point_lost: The titan's back has changed shape. Your resting place has faded, and you wake elsewhere
message.skyabyss.trials_renewed: The stone whale's heart beats again, a beat rising from far below. The trials await in a new shape
message.skyabyss.trials_peaceful: The titan does not wake. (While the difficulty is Peaceful, the trials sleep)
message.skyabyss.heart_defeated: The heart of the stone whale has stopped. The great body breathes out at last
message.skyabyss.heart_pillar: The light pillar carried you back to the tail platform
message.skyabyss.mid_boss_reward: The sentinel captain falls. Deeper within, the heart still sleeps
message.skyabyss.pedestal_sleep: The pedestal sleeps. Defeat the heart deep within and the Sky Key Fragment will answer
item.skyabyss.whalebone_greatsword.desc: Heavy and slow, but its bone-deep blow slows the foe
item.skyabyss.stone_whale_armor.desc: Wear all four and the rock's protection dwells in you
item.skyabyss.resonance_charm.desc: Use it to close wounds and shield yourself (rests for 1 minute)
message.skyabyss.gave_up: The blue flame flickers, and you find yourself on the tail platform
message.skyabyss.campfire_hint: Sneak and touch the campfire to give up and return to the entrance
message.skyabyss.whisper.plaza: Touch the anchor stone to ride the chain down. The Resonance Forge beside it tempers gear with shards
message.skyabyss.whisper.shrine: Beneath the shrine, the titan's heartbeat sleeps. The three trials wait beyond it
message.skyabyss.whisper.hub: When three stones sing, the north door will breathe
message.skyabyss.whisper.treasury: Deeper still, something is beating. The pedestal still sleeps
message.skyabyss.whisper.w0: Beyond lies the rift. If you fall, you return to this rest point
message.skyabyss.whisper.w2: The last bridge is crumbling all over
message.skyabyss.whisper.e0: Guards sleep in the halls ahead. Face them together
message.skyabyss.whisper.heart: Defeat what beats within, and the way will open
message.skyabyss.whisper.ridge: An old stone gate and broken pillars lie half-buried along the spine. The head lies far north; the fins reach out over the clouds.
item.skyabyss.captain_pike.desc: Reaches a frontal arc. Every third hit erupts bone
item.skyabyss.waterway_fang.desc: +30%% attack speed underwater. Hits cause bleeding
item.skyabyss.stone_whale_plating.desc: While slotted: +3 armor toughness with 2 Stone Whale pieces, knockback resistance with 4
item.skyabyss.moss_talisman.desc: While slotted, slowly heals you on moss
item.skyabyss.bone_spike_arrow.desc: A heavy bone head. Causes bleeding for 3 seconds
item.skyabyss.stone_whale_shard.desc: Dropped on the whale's back. Used to enhance gear at the forge
item.skyabyss.resonance_crystal.desc: A titan's song turned to crystal. Used to enhance gear
item.skyabyss.resonance_shard.desc: A Resonance Fragment from before they were split by titan. Works for any titan's exclusive trade. No longer dropped
item.skyabyss.resonance_shard_stone_whal: The Stone Whale's Resonance Fragment. 30 trade for a Stone Whale exclusive. Also returned when you dismantle Stone Whale legendaries
item.skyabyss.resonance_shard_tide_shell: The Tide Shell's Resonance Fragment. 30 trade for a Tide Shell exclusive. Also returned when you dismantle Tide Shell legendaries
item.skyabyss.resonance_shard_thunder_wi: The Thunder Wing's Resonance Fragment. 30 trade for a Thunder Wing exclusive. Also returned when you dismantle Thunder Wing legendaries
item.skyabyss.resonance_shard_ember.desc: The Ember Titan's Resonance Fragment. 30 trade for an Ember exclusive. Also returned when you dismantle Ember legendaries
item.skyabyss.stone_whale_core.desc: A piece of the stone whale's heart. Material for a future relic
gui.skyabyss.forge.yield_resonance: Yields %s Stone Whale Resonance Fragments, %s Stone Whale Scales
message.skyabyss.boss_reward: What the heart of the stone whale left behind passes into your hands
message.skyabyss.memory_next_guaranteed: Next heart kill guarantees a piece you don't have yet
message.skyabyss.memory_all_owned: The memory knows every shape already; it returns as Resonance Fragments
message.skyabyss.legendary_dupe: Legendary %s appeared again (dismantle it at the forge)
message.skyabyss.first_clear: First clear. The whale offers you one memory — choose
message.skyabyss.first_clear_hint: Click a name to receive it (/titanmemory to see the choice again)
message.skyabyss.first_clear_none: There is no first-clear reward to choose
message.skyabyss.reward_pending: Rewards you couldn't receive are being held. You get them when you wake (or with /titanmemory claim)
message.skyabyss.reward_overflow: Your inventory is full; %s reward(s) are being held. Make room and use /titanmemory claim
message.skyabyss.reward_delivered: You received the rewards that were held for you
message.skyabyss.reward_none_pending: No rewards are being held for you
gui.skyabyss.growth.title: Record of the One Who Remains
gui.skyabyss.growth.fragments_desc: Memories that survive the falling moon. Only the vessel exists for now; their power has not yet awakened.
gui.skyabyss.growth.desc.strength: Each point raises melee damage by 0.6%, multiplied with your weapon.
gui.skyabyss.growth.desc.agility: Each point: movement speed +0.2%, attack speed +0.2%, projectile damage +0.4%.
gui.skyabyss.growth.desc.spirit: Each point adds 2 max mana. The arts that use mana have not yet awakened.
gui.skyabyss.growth.desc.vitality: Every 2 points add 0.25❤ of max health.
gui.skyabyss.growth.cap: Each stat caps at %s. Hold Shift to add 5 at a time.
message.skyabyss.growth.title: Record of the One Who Remains
message.skyabyss.growth.level_up: You reached level %s. %s more points to spend.
message.skyabyss.growth.max_level: From here on, only memories accumulate.
message.skyabyss.growth.open_hint: Press %s to spend your points (or see /growth)
message.skyabyss.growth.allocate_failed: Cannot spend those points (not enough points, or the stat is at its cap)
gui.skyabyss.growth.respec_free: Near a Resonance Forge (within %2$s blocks): take back every point you spent on stats. Free this time.
gui.skyabyss.growth.respec_cost: Near a Resonance Forge (within %2$s blocks): pay %1$s Resonance Crystals to take back every point you spent on stats.
message.skyabyss.growth.respec_done: The forge's heat loosens your strength. All stat points are back.
message.skyabyss.growth.respec_failed.no: You can only reset near a Resonance Forge
message.skyabyss.growth.unknown_stat: No such stat (strength, agility, spirit, vitality)
message.skyabyss.growth.fragment_gained: The memory fragment "%s" settles in the vessel (%s / %s)
message.skyabyss.growth.fragment_full: The vessel is full; %s did not settle
message.skyabyss.growth.summary: %s: Lv %s (%s / %s) STR %s, AGI %s, SPI %s, VIT %s, %s unspent, fragments %s / %s
message.skyabyss.growth.points: Points to spend: %s (use the screen or /growth add <stat> [n])
message.skyabyss.growth.effects: Melee +%s%%  Speed +%s%%  Ranged +%s%%  Health +%s  Max mana %s
skilltree.skyabyss.sword.desc: Close-range arts that grow with Strength. The bigger the foe, the harder they land.
skilltree.skyabyss.bow.desc: Shooting arts that grow with Agility. Strike from afar, for your companions.
skilltree.skyabyss.star.desc: Arts of Spirit. They are said to shield with moonlight and slow the flow of time.
skilltree.skyabyss.star.sealed: Awakens when you cross to the moon (Chapter 3).
skilltree.skyabyss.abyss.desc: Arts of Spirit and Vitality. They are said to strike with a heartbeat and slip into shadow.
skilltree.skyabyss.abyss.sealed: Awakens at the bottom of the abyss (Chapter 2).
skill.skyabyss.titan_cleave.flavor: Cut the mountain, the people of the back taught. Mountains sometimes walk.
skill.skyabyss.titan_cleave.effect: Hits up to 5 foes in a cone ahead (radius 4) for %1$s%% of your attack damage. Large foes (captain, heart, golems...) take %2$sx that.
skill.skyabyss.riposte.flavor: The whalebone guards strike back as hard as they are struck.
skill.skyabyss.riposte.effect: Within %2$s seconds after a creature hurts you, your next melee hit deals +%1$s%%.
skill.skyabyss.lunge.flavor: The distance belongs to whoever steps in.
skill.skyabyss.lunge.effect: Close in on a foe you look at within %1$s blocks and strike for %2$s%% of your attack damage. Only on solid ground; never steps off a ledge.
skill.skyabyss.stone_stance.flavor: Stone is not swept away. The current bends instead.
skill.skyabyss.whale_sweep.flavor: What swims through the sky sweeps everything aside with its tail.
skill.skyabyss.whale_sweep.effect: Spin and hit every foe around you (radius %1$s) for %2$s%% of your attack damage, pushing them back a little.
skill.skyabyss.cloud_pierce.flavor: Something is still out there, beyond the clouds.
skill.skyabyss.cloud_pierce.effect: Loose a straight-flying arrow without drawing (uses 1 arrow). Damage %1$s, pierces up to %2$s foes. Bow enchantments apply.
skill.skyabyss.far_shot.flavor: Eyes that see far can shoot far.
skill.skyabyss.far_shot.effect: Projectiles deal more the farther the target. Up to +%1$s%% (at %2$s blocks or more).
skill.skyabyss.backstep.effect: Hop backwards. Only on solid ground with a foe within %1$s blocks.
skill.skyabyss.hawk_eye.effect: Your arrows mark foes for %2$s seconds (they glow). Marked foes take +%1$s%% damage from everyone.
skill.skyabyss.sky_rain.flavor: Sometimes the sky takes your side.
skill.skyabyss.sky_rain.effect: Light falls %2$s times on a radius-%1$s area you look at (24 blocks). %3$s damage each, grows with Agility. Foes only; no arrows used.
gui.skyabyss.skill.title: Carved Arts
gui.skyabyss.skill.respec_free: Near a Resonance Forge (within %2$s blocks): forget every art and get your skill points back. Free this time.
gui.skyabyss.skill.respec_cost: Near a Resonance Forge (within %2$s blocks): pay %1$s Resonance Crystals to forget every art and get your skill points back.

gui.skyabyss.skill.passive_active: Learned: always in effect (no slot needed)
gui.skyabyss.skill.passive_hint: Works once learned; not placed in a slot
gui.skyabyss.skill.slot_hint: Select it, then click a slot below

message.skyabyss.skill.first_hint: You can learn one art. Choose it on the %s screen (or see /skill)
message.skyabyss.skill.learn_failed.requ: You have not learned the art before it
message.skyabyss.skill.respec_done: The carved arts return to the stone. All skill points are back.
message.skyabyss.skill.respec_failed.no_: You can only reset near a Resonance Forge
message.skyabyss.skill.slot_failed: Cannot place that there (not a learned active art)

commands.skyabyss.playtest.help.0: [試遊] /skyabyss playtest ... (最後に [対象]、省略は自分)
commands.skyabyss.playtest.help.1: now: 今の目的の出来事をその場で起こす / next: 今の目的を済ませて次を起こす
commands.skyabyss.playtest.help.2: skip opening: 序章を済ませる / whale: 岩鯨を呼び鎖を下ろす
commands.skyabyss.playtest.help.3: board <whale|tide|storm|ember>: その背中へ乗せる
commands.skyabyss.playtest.help.4: goto <titan> <休み場 id|heart|hub>: 背中の中を移す
commands.skyabyss.playtest.help.5: trials <titan>: 試練・石を済ませ、扉を開ける
commands.skyabyss.playtest.help.6: gear <0-4|titan>: その章の装備・体力・レベル
commands.skyabyss.playtest.help.11: 例: board whale @a → trials whale @a → goto whale heart @a
commands.skyabyss.playtest.now.awake: Triggered the waking scene. Look around and start walking
commands.skyabyss.playtest.now.camp: Revealed the camp clue. Look for the camp with the notebook
commands.skyabyss.playtest.now.trail: Rang the trail bell. Head toward the sound
commands.skyabyss.playtest.now.footprint: Unlocked the giant footprints lore. Go see the footprints
commands.skyabyss.playtest.now.shadow: Sent the shadow across the sky. Look up
commands.skyabyss.playtest.now.storytell: Spawned the storyteller in front of you. Talk to them
commands.skyabyss.playtest.now.footsteps: Played the night footsteps (set to night). Listen and wait
commands.skyabyss.playtest.now.isana: Spawned Isana in front of you. Talk to her
commands.skyabyss.playtest.now.bones: Unlocked the bone hill lore. Read it
commands.skyabyss.playtest.now.song: Played the sky song (set to night). Listen to the end
